claude_detail.step_description: Collected river water, enriched it on PAO1, and isolated a plaque-purified phage lysate
Extracted phage DNA with a commercial kit and prepared it for Nanopore sequencing
Base-called raw Nanopore signal into FASTQ reads using Guppy
Filtered reads for quality using Filtlong
Assembled filtered long reads into a single circular contig using Flye
Polished the draft assembly using Medaka to produce the final genome
Annotated the phage genome with gene calls and functional predictions using BV-BRC's bacteriophage annotation pipeline based on PHANOTATE
Refined functional predictions for gene products using InterProScan protein domain analysis
Refined functional predictions for gene products using an unnamed sequence-comparison tool, inferred to be a BLAST-style search
Attempted to determine genome termini and packaging mechanism using PhageTerm
Mapped reads back to the assembly to assess coverage uniformity
Searched the whole genome against public databases with an unnamed tool to identify related phages by sequence identity

copilot_detail.step_description: Base calling of Nanopore sequencing reads using Guppy software
Quality filtering of sequencing reads using Filtlong
Assembly of filtered reads into a circular genome contig using Flye
Polishing of the assembled genome using Medaka
Automatic genome annotation using BV-BRC annotation service with PHANOTATE
Functional prediction of gene products using InterProScan
BLAST search of the genome against sequence databases
Read mapping to the assembly to assess coverage distribution
